description: This file defines an Angular component named LoginComponent that provides a reactive login form with email and password fields, handles form submission, and manages component lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: LoginComponent
classes.description: An Angular component implementing a login form with reactive validation and submission handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the reactive form with validators.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up any subscriptions when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles the form submission, performing validation checks, simulating login, and toggling submission state.

methods.name: invalid
methods.description: Checks whether a specific form control ('email' or 'password') is invalid and touched or dirty.

ctags.name: g
ctags.pattern: /^    const g: any = (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : undefined);$/
